ne18:2.1: yo dhammo yaṃ dhammaṃ janayati, tassa so parikkhāro.
ne18:2.4: dve dhammā janayanti: hetu ca paccayo ca.
ne18:2.8: yathā aṃkurassa nipphattiyā bījaṃ asādhāraṇaṃ, paṭhavī āpo ca sādhāraṇā.
ne18:2.9: aṅkurassa hi paṭhavī āpo ca paccayo, sabhāvo hetu,
ne18:2.10: yathā vā pana ghaṭe duddhaṃ pakkhittaṃ dadhi bhavati, na catthi ekakālasamavadhānaṃ duddhassa ca dadhissa ca,
ne18:2.11: evameva natthi ekakālasamavadhānaṃ hetussa ca paccayassa ca.
ne18:3.2: vuttaṃ hi: “avijjāpaccāya saṅkhārā, saṅkhārāpaccayā viññāṇaṃ”. evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo.
ne18:3.3: iti avijjā avijjāhetu, ayoniso manasikāro paccayo.
ne18:3.5: tattha purimikā avijjā avijjānusayo, pacchimikā avijjā avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ. purimiko avijjānusayo pacchimikassa avijjāpariyuṭṭhānassa hetubhūto paribrūhanāya bījaṅkuro viya samanantarahetutāya.
ne18:3.6: yaṃ pana yattha phalaṃ nibbattati, idaṃ tassa paramparahetutāya hetubhūtaṃ.
ne18:3.7: duvidho hi hetu: samanantarahetu paramparahetu ca. evaṃ avijjāyapi duvidho hetu: samanantarahetu paramparahetu ca.
ne18:4.1: yathā vā pana thālakañca vaṭṭi ca telañca padīpassa paccayabhūtaṃ, na sabhāvahetu, na hi sakkā thālakaṃ ca vaṭṭiṃ ca telañca anaggikaṃ dīpetuṃ, padīpassa paccayabhūtaṃ.
ne18:5.1: avupacchedattho santatiattho, nibbattiattho phalattho, paṭisandhiattho punabbhavattho, sampaḷibodhattho pariyuṭṭhānattho, asamugghātattho anusayattho, asampaṭivedhattho avijjattho, apariññātattho viññāṇassa bījattho.
ne18:5.2: yattha avupacchedo tattha santati, yattha santati tattha nibbatti, yatthi nibbatti tattha phalaṃ, yattha phalaṃ tattha paṭisandhi, yattha paṭisandhi tattha punabbhavo, yattha punabbhavo tattha paḷibodo, yattha paḷibodho tattha pariyuṭṭhānaṃ, yattha pariyuṭṭhānaṃ tattha asamugghāto,
ne18:5.3: yattha asamugghāto tattha anusayo, yattha anusayo tattha asampaṭivedho, yattha asampaṭivedho tattha avijjā, yattha avijjā tattha sāsavaṃ viññāṇaṃ apariññātaṃ, yattha sāsavaṃ viññāṇaṃ apariññātaṃ tattha bījattho.
ne18:6.1: sīlakkhandho samādhikkhandhassa paccayo, samādhikkhandho, paññākkhandhassa paccayo, paññākkhandho vimuttikkhandhassa paccayo, vimuttikkhandho vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhassa paccayo.
ne18:6.2: titthaññūtā pītaññūtāya paccayo, pītaññutā pattaññutāya paccayo, pattaññutā attaññutāya paccayo.
ne18:7.1: yathā vā pana cakkhuṃ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ,
ne18:7.2: tattha cakkhu ādhipateyyapaccayatāya paccayo, rūpā ārammaṇapaccayatāya paccayo,
ne18:7.3: āloko sannissayatāya paccayo, manasikāro sabhāvo hetu.
ne18:7.19: evaṃ yo koci upanissayo, sabbo so parikkhāro.
ne18:7.20: tenāha āyasmā mahākaccāyano: “ye dhammā yaṃ dhammaṃ janayantī”ti.
